title: VaultTec — Phase 6 Win-Rate Test Report
method: Three new wide-6 variants (6% stop / 9% target, 1.5:1, 10-day exit) on OOS-1/2/3 + FRESH-1/2/3/4, delayed real yfinance history from the disk cache (no Yahoo re-fetch), 12 symbols, walk-forward, signals from history up to the trade day only — no look-ahead. Every trade goes through the real PaperTradingEngine and Risk Engine, balanced profile, $10,000 virtual cash, long-only. (1) High-confidence-only: RSI + Bollinger wide-6 only when the explainable signal is long with confidence >= 0.70 (app scanner floor is 0.55). (2) Volume confirmation: same entries only when the entry bar's volume is above its 20-day average (ratio > 1.0). (3) Combined: mean-reversion wide-6 (RSI + Bollinger, 5-day grid) PLUS MACD trend-following (every bar) in one shared $10,000 portfolio, at most one trade per symbol per day. The wide-6 baseline is re-run on the same windows so the comparison is like-for-like. Every variant keeps a stop-loss; the stop is never removed.
data_source: yfinance (delayed real market data, free — Yahoo Finance), from data/fresh-cache/
verdict_rule: Worth keeping = pooled fresh P&L > $0 AND pooled fresh win rate > 40% AND positive in at least 2 fresh windows AND pooled OOS P&L > $0. The same pool rule is also reported for the OOS pool on its own.

note: Nothing here proves future profits: past performance does not guarantee future results. Three new variants were tested on the same seven windows the lead was picked on, so the best-looking one is partly the best by chance (multiple comparisons) — a variant that only looks good here needs a fresh window and live paper trades over real days before it is trusted. Combined trade counts are not directly comparable with single-strategy counts (MACD is checked every bar, mean-reversion on a 5-day grid) — P&L, win rate and expectancy per trade are the comparison. Live paper evidence is still Day 1 only (2026-11-09: 3 trades open, 0 closed, $0 realised) and proves nothing yet. A compliance/legal review is still required before any real money is considered.
